title: growth-signal-huddle-brief-talia-gomez-feb06-2028
content:
Purpose: quick personal scratchpad for the 1:1 with Ivy (report). Keep this tight — focus on current sprint signals, two growth topics, and 3 concrete action items.

Meeting details:
- With: Ivy Han (senior ML infra eng)
- When: 2028-02-06, 10:30am (30m)
- Location: Zoom / async notes to be pasted in #eng-1on1s

Top-of-mind (what I want to get out of this):
- Make sure Ivy feels unblocked on the prefix-cache experiment (latency regressions flagged).
- Align on next steps for career stretch into product-facing ownership (roadmap & metrics).
- Confirm capacity to pick up a short-term on-call doc improvement task.

Quick status snapshot (from slack / PRs / recent standups):
- Prefix-cache experiment: feature branch, merged but perf tests show +12ms p50 on 2048-seq in canary. Flamegraph points to cache eviction path. PR: github.com/rw-inference/serving-runtime/pull/987.
- Eval harness: Ivy ran evals against 3 prompts, observed no quality degradation.
- Mentorship: Ivy paired with Ravi last week on kernel selection notes; Ravi left a comment with suggestions.

Agenda outline (30m):
1) 3m - quick personal check-in (energy, any external blockers)
2) 8m - prefix-cache perf regression: readings + hypotheses + immediate mitigations
3) 8m - career stretch discussion: what "product-facing ownership" looks like, concrete first project, metrics to track
4) 6m - short operational tasks (on-call doc, runbook edits, low-priority infra bugs) and timing
5) 5m - closing: confirm actions, calendar/time commitments, any follow-ups I should own

Notes-to-self / prompts to ask Ivy:
- "Walk me through the perf regression timeline — when did the +12ms first appear, and what changed around that time?"
- "If we roll back the eviction change, does p50 go back down? How risky is that rollback?"
- "For PD ownership, what specific cross-team stakeholder would you like exposure to first (reliability, product infra, customer-eng)?"
- "What would success look like for you in 6 weeks if you take this stretch?"
- "Are there any blockers on taking on the on-call doc task (bandwidth, permissions, unclear owner)?"

Hypotheses / talking bullets on prefix-cache:
- Hypothesis A: eviction accounting introduces serialization in hot-path under high concurrent sessions. Tiny lock in cache->evict.
- Hypothesis B: new kernel selection fallthrough is causing extra KV lookups for warm prefixes.
- Quick mitigation to propose: flip flag to the previous eviction policy in staged canary while we profile.
- If rollback not acceptable, ask Ivy to produce a minimal repro sketch and I will pull SRE for an assisted profilng session (schedule 1 hour).

Career stretch (product-facing ownership) starter plan (coaching notes):
- Proposal: Ivy leads a 6-week "route to production" project owning a rollout of the new cache policy to Dedicated customers. Key deliverables: rollout checklist, targeted evals, perf regression mitigation plan, stakeholder updates.
- Success metrics: (a) deployment checklist completed, (b) less than 3% latency regressions at p50 across test orgs, (c) stakeholder sign-off from product PM and SRE lead.
- Support I will provide: help scope the first milestone, intro to PM (Sarah Lee), weekly 15-min check-ins, and help negotiate time with feature team during sprint planning.

Operational bite-sized tasks I might ask her to volunteer for:
- Draft on-call runbook entry for cache eviction incidents (target: 1h draft + 30m review) -> due 2028-02-13
- Triage infra-bug JIRA-2375 (low priority) and estimate fix scope -> due 2028-02-10
- Add a short section to the serving-runtime README describing toggles for eviction policy (small doc PR) -> due 2028-02-12

Action items (explicit, each line: owner — action — due):
- Ivy Han — Create minimal repro for +12ms p50 and attach perf flamegraph to PR #987 — due 2028-02-09
- Talia Gomez — Set up 1-hr profiling session with SRE (Ravi) if repro shows lock contention — due 2028-02-08
- Ivy Han — Draft on-call runbook cache-evict.md and open doc PR for review — due 2028-02-13
- Talia Gomez & Ivy Han — Sync with PM Sarah Lee to scope product-facing ownership pilot (15m intro) — schedule by 2028-02-10

Open questions (to resolve in meeting or asynchronously):
- Do we have historical perf baselines across orgs for p50/95 on 2048-seq? (If not, ask observability to backfill)
- Is the dedicated capacity canary configuration representative of production concurrency?
- What is Ivy's bandwidth next sprint if she takes the 6-week pilot? (need to preempt tasks that would conflict)

Notes to capture in meeting and paste into Slack/Confluence after:
- Short summary of the regression, next steps, and who owns the runbook/task.
- If we schedule profiling session, include a short agenda and expected outputs (e.g., lock owner, heatmap).

Tone reminders (for myself):
- Be concise and practical — Ivy prefers technical clarity over managerial platitudes.
- Ask clarifying technical questions before jumping to managerial solutions.
- Offer the pilot as a collaborative experiment; negotiate time and visibility rather than mandate.

Post-meeting follow-up checklist (I own unless otherwise noted):
- Paste notes into #eng-1on1s and link PR #987, JIRA-2375, and runbook draft — due same day (2028-02-06)
- If repro confirmed, schedule profiling with Ravi and SRE team and add calendar invite — due 2028-02-07
- Draft a short intro email to PM Sarah Lee making the case for Ivy's pilot and cc Ivy — due 2028-02-09

Random scratch / brain dump (unstructured):
- Ivy mentioned wanting "more product context" — maybe pair her with a PM for 2 hours shadowing during roadmap review.
- Consider small badge recognition if the pilot goes well (internal shoutout in engineering all-hands).
- If eviction policy rollback removes the regression, think through automated test to prevent future regressions (alert on p50 delta > 5ms post-deploy).

End of scratchpad. Save this after meeting and convert to a short summary for Confluence with actions and links.
